posts.body:
A Celestial Weapon
After having been remade in Rpg Maker MV, and Rpg Maker MZ, I've finally come to the conclusion that the original version of A Celestial Weapon is the only one which runs with no problems at all... - MoonWolfV
Plot
​
Soldaria, the totalitarian regime run by the despot (and who knows if he really does exist) Mr. B. Almost all members of the Soldarian government are crooked, but the worst of the bunch is by far the beautiful - and with an ego to match it, General Jodie Felchers. She recently organised the downing of their neighbour's advanced orbital solar power plant to turn it into a superweapon for her own ends. As far as the general public are to be aware, they are supposed to believe that this was simply a meteor coming down and landing south of the capital of Canaburg, but there is one resident skeptic in the city who is not going to fall for that.
Meet Sophie, Canaburg's resident skeptic. She, her good friend James, and their accomplice Vincent, go into the military archives and find the documentation confirming Sophie's theory about this "meteor". Along the way, they pick up some likely and unlikely friends to join their team. The techno-whiz  - Jared, the sorceress with violent mood-swings - Heather, a head chemist who also couldn't help satisfy his curiosity - Richard, and a thief who bungled a crime in Sagarisk, Tania.
This team head across the strait to Senecia, hopefully the government of Senecia will heed their warning before it's too late!
The download for A Celestial Weapon can be found at:
https://moonwolfv.itch.io/a-celestial-weapon
